objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled information object that manages company-wide regulations and instructions from creation through release, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Classification of the document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document (Editing, In Review, Released, Archived, Out of Force)

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation (e.g., RL, PI, WI)

attributes.name: sequentialnumber
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive number for each document type

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is automatically released with the main document and triggers versioning.

objs.name: additionalinformation
objs.description: An uncontrolled document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not trigger versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in various roles and capacities.

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A group of users with shared authorizations and responsibilities.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A suggestion to modify an existing document that does not affect the document's content or version history.

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: A request to confirm or extend the validity period of a document.

objs.name: archivingrequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that is no longer valid.

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously archived and invalidated document.

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A maintained list of Users and UserGroups assigned to receive a document upon release.

objs.name: language
objs.description: A language version in which a document can be translated and released.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate organizational context in a multi-client system where document visibility and modifications can be controlled.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with a document type and optional template selection.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modify the textual or structural content of a document using an editing client.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Add or update standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes of a document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read, write, or role-specific permissions to Users or UserGroups for a document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document content from source format to PDF format.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document attachment to a main document.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add an uncontrolled document attachment that does not trigger versioning of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose a modification to an existing document without affecting its version history.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically sign a document by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check the content and formal aspects of a document as a reviewer in the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document as a releaser in the workflow, making it available to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to readers on the web.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version of a document when changes trigger versioning.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as archived, to be physically removed after the next document version release.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Generate a request to verify and extend the validity period of a released document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm or extend the validity period of a document by updating its ValidUntil date.

evts.name: create_archiving_request
evts.description: Generate a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document as out of force and withdraw authorizations from users.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Generate a request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status and create a new version.

evts.name: assign_distribution
evts.description: Add Users or UserGroups to a document's distribution list for notification or acknowledgement.

evts.name: send_distribution_notification
evts.description: Automatically notify Users and UserGroups on the distribution list about a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document by a reader.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw all authorizations except archive group access and archive the document for a defined period.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically remove a document after the archive period expires.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Restore an archived attachment when its associated document is reactivated.

evts.name: display_audit_trail
evts.description: Present the complete traceability and signature documentation for released document versions.
